soldiers_buckle.name: Soldier's Buckle
soldiers_buckle.description: A plain iron buckle etched with a guard oath.

embershard_focus.name: Embershard Focus
embershard_focus.description: Warm crystal splinters sharpen simple spellwork for a short stretch.

keen_edge_oil.name: Keen Edge Oil
keen_edge_oil.description: A quick coat makes weapon strikes bite deeper.

healers_brooch.name: Healer's Brooch
healers_brooch.description: A tiny clasp that makes every potion feel carefully brewed.

quickstep_charm.name: Quickstep Charm
quickstep_charm.description: A cord charm that urges your feet through danger.

amulet_of_vigor.name: Amulet of Vigor
amulet_of_vigor.description: A green-glass pendant that steadies breath and blood.

duelist_gloves.name: Duelist Gloves
duelist_gloves.description: Supple leather gloves cut for fast, accurate strikes.

wand_of_cinders.name: Wand of Cinders
wand_of_cinders.description: A soot-dark wand that flares when battle starts.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.description: Somehow, treasure always lands face up.

scholars_lens.name: Scholar's Lens
scholars_lens.description: Every fight teaches a little more than it should.

giant_bane_grip.name: Giant-Bane Grip
giant_bane_grip.description: A weapon wrap said to remember impossible victories.

moonleaf_cloak.name: Moonleaf Cloak
moonleaf_cloak.description: A quiet cloak that seems to move before the wind does.

aether_prism.name: Aether Prism
aether_prism.description: A faceted stone that catches spell-light from strange angles.

boots_of_the_hare.name: Boots of the Hare
boots_of_the_hare.description: Light boots with soles that never quite touch mud.

sunward_periapt.name: Sunward Periapt
sunward_periapt.description: A bright charm that makes wounds close cleaner.

flameheart_talisman.name: Flameheart Talisman
flameheart_talisman.description: A pulsing talisman that rewards bold spellcasting.

kingsroad_aegis.name: Kingsroad Aegis
kingsroad_aegis.description: An old royal charm, sturdy enough to make a shield jealous.

starfallen_sigil.name: Starfallen Sigil
starfallen_sigil.description: A silver mark that hums with patient, dangerous power.

heartwood_crown.name: Heartwood Crown
heartwood_crown.description: Living roots woven into a crown for anyone stubborn enough to survive them.

ironroot_ring.name: Ironroot Ring
ironroot_ring.description: A rough wooden ring reinforced with a thin band of iron.

sparkwire_wrap.name: Sparkwire Wrap
sparkwire_wrap.description: Copper thread wound around a weapon grip to sharpen its first few strikes.

menders_sachet.name: Mender's Sachet
menders_sachet.description: A fragrant packet of bitter herbs tucked beside a potion flask.

windknotted_thread.name: Windknotted Thread
windknotted_thread.description: A pale cord tied in seven knots, each tugging faintly toward open ground.

chalk_rune_tablet.name: Chalk Rune Tablet
chalk_rune_tablet.description: A brittle slate covered in cramped formulae that brighten around active magic.

scavengers_token.name: Scavenger's Token
scavengers_token.description: A brass token passed between delvers who know where to look twice.

drillmasters_whistle.name: Drillmaster's Whistle
drillmasters_whistle.description: Its shrill note has a way of making hard lessons stick.

brambleguard_clasp.name: Brambleguard Clasp
brambleguard_clasp.description: A thorn-shaped bronze clasp that seems to stiffen when danger draws near.

stormglass_bead.name: Stormglass Bead
stormglass_bead.description: A cloudy blue bead with tiny flashes trapped beneath its surface.

cutpurses_favor.name: Cutpurse's Favor
cutpurses_favor.description: A crooked silver charm that makes loose coin strangely easy to notice.

redstep_spurs.name: Redstep Spurs
redstep_spurs.description: Small iron spurs that click once just before their wearer moves.

apothecarys_cup.name: Apothecary's Cup
apothecarys_cup.description: A tiny measuring cup engraved with ratios no modern herbalist recognizes.

veterans_whetstone.name: Veteran's Whetstone
veterans_whetstone.description: A scarred stone polished smooth by blades that survived many campaigns.

wayfinders_compass.name: Wayfinder's Compass
wayfinders_compass.description: Its needle ignores north and points instead toward momentum.

runebound_bracer.name: Runebound Bracer
runebound_bracer.description: An old leather bracer inset with a rune that warms whenever steel is drawn.

glass_magus_eye.name: Glass Magus Eye
glass_magus_eye.description: A polished crystal lens that fractures spell-light into sharper patterns.

pilgrims_greaves.name: Pilgrim's Greaves
pilgrims_greaves.description: Weathered greaves said to grow lighter the farther their wearer travels.

gilded_beetle.name: Gilded Beetle
gilded_beetle.description: A jeweled beetle figurine that always seems to turn up beside hidden valuables.

saints_phial.name: Saint's Phial
saints_phial.description: An empty crystal vial that somehow improves anything restorative poured nearby.

war_scholars_codex.name: War Scholar's Codex
war_scholars_codex.description: A battered field manual annotated by generations of adventurers.

blackoak_ward.name: Blackoak Ward
blackoak_ward.description: A dark wooden token dense enough to feel more like stone than timber.

phoenix_ash_reliquary.name: Phoenix-Ash Reliquary
phoenix_ash_reliquary.description: A thumb-sized reliquary containing ash that never cools completely.

wyvernscale_mantle.name: Wyvernscale Mantle
wyvernscale_mantle.description: Overlapping scales sewn into a shoulder mantle that turns blows with a dry hiss.

chronomancers_pin.name: Chronomancer's Pin
chronomancers_pin.description: The tiny hands on this silver pin occasionally twitch backward.

deepdelvers_lantern.name: Deepdelver's Lantern
deepdelvers_lantern.description: A hooded lantern whose pale flame seems brightest near danger and treasure alike.

titanblood_torc.name: Titanblood Torc
titanblood_torc.description: A heavy bronze neck-ring that beats faintly like a second pulse.

crown_of_the_first_flame.name: Crown of the First Flame
crown_of_the_first_flame.description: A blackened circlet crowned by an ember that has supposedly burned since magic first entered the world.

worldbreaker_gauntlet.name: Worldbreaker Gauntlet
worldbreaker_gauntlet.description: A massive rune-marked gauntlet whose knuckles bear dents no mortal smith can explain.

fortune_eaters_idol.name: Fortune-Eater's Idol
fortune_eaters_idol.description: A grinning golden idol that grows heavier after every victory.

charred_horseshoe.name: Charred Horseshoe
charred_horseshoe.description: A smoke-black iron shoe that still remembers the open road.

harvesters_gloves.name: Harvester's Gloves
harvesters_gloves.description: Thick gloves stitched with warding straw and sharpened copper thread.

cinderheart_locket.name: Cinderheart Locket
cinderheart_locket.description: A warm brass locket containing the last clean ember of the Farmstead.

aegis_of_the_last_king.name: Aegis of the Last King
aegis_of_the_last_king.description: A broken royal seal said to carry the stubbornness of a kingdom that refused to fall.
